info.title: Telematics
info.description: Inside of **Decisiv SRM Gateway**, the `Telematics` module represents all interactions and functionality which an Account enabled with `Telematics subscription` can perform through an API interface.

get.summary: List all diagnostic readings for the requested account
get.description: Retrieve all diagnostic readings for a specific SRM account.

parameters.name: filter[asset_data.chassis_id]
parameters.description: Filters diagnostic readings by exact match on `asset_data.chassis_id`

parameters.name: filter[asset_data.device_id]
parameters.description: Filters diagnostic readings by exact match on `asset_data.device_id`

parameters.name: filter[asset_data.serial_number]
parameters.description: Filters diagnostic readings by exact match on `asset_data.serial_number`

parameters.name: filter[asset_data.vin]
parameters.description: Filters diagnostic readings by exact match on `asset_data.vin`

parameters.name: filter[origin]
parameters.description: Filters diagnostic readings by exact match on `origin`

parameters.name: filter[triggered_at:gt]
parameters.description: Returns diagnostic readings with `triggered_at` strictly greater than the provided `ISO8601` date-time

parameters.name: filter[triggered_at:gte]
parameters.description: Returns diagnostic readings with `triggered_at` greater than or equal to the provided `ISO8601` date-time

parameters.name: filter[triggered_at:lt]
parameters.description: Returns diagnostic readings with `triggered_at` strictly less than the provided `ISO8601` date-time

parameters.name: filter[triggered_at:lte]
parameters.description: Returns diagnostic readings with `triggered_at` less than or equal to the provided `ISO8601` date-time
